subject.title: Feature: Built-in pace-aware rate limiting for autonomous agents

question: What pace-aware quota policy should OpenClaw core own for autonomous agents?
rationale: The remaining work adds new config/defaults, persisted usage state, provider-specific usage semantics, and automatic blocking/throttling behavior that cannot be safely chosen by automation.

options.title: Visibility-first pace context
options.body: Calculate and expose pace context from existing usage windows in status/session_status and agent context, but do not block work until maintainers validate the policy.

options.title: Opt-in subagent throttling
options.body: Add config-gated subagent spawn throttling after pace context exists, with tests for default compatibility and explicit opt-in behavior.

options.title: Fold into broad rate-limit governance
options.body: Make #13615 or a successor design the canonical owner for pace, budgets, and provider request limits to avoid parallel config surfaces.

recommendation.title: Visibility-first pace context
recommendation.body: Calculate and expose pace context from existing usage windows in status/session_status and agent context, but do not block work until maintainers validate the policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans product/API scope and provider usage/status history where steipete has the strongest historical signal.
